title: Hanasato Minori — Expanding Circle Of Friendship〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So... Minori, Kohane...
Friends?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yup, friends!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. This is great!
We became much, much closer just like that!
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, we're all here.
Let's start our little run!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You seem awfully happy, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Were you looking forward to this that much?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! We usually run by ourselves since we all run at different speeds.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There's also somewhere I'd like to stop by while we're doing this!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Where?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Somewhere with really pretty cherry blossoms in full bloom!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I went to see them with some of my classmates the other day and want you to see them too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Cherry blossoms... That sounds nice...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It does. I haven't had a chance this year to go see any either...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me neither. Let's make it the last stop for our run.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay!
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, over here!
The cherry blossoms are still...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Nooo!! What happened?!
There were so many more last time...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's been pretty breezy lately, so they might've gotten blown away...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But...
I should've shown you guys sooner then...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our streams have been keeping us busy, so I'm not really sure we could've...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But they were so beautiful. I really wanted everyone to see them... Oh, wait...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They really are beautiful, even though they're a little past their peak.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
It really feels like spring now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. Thank you for bringing us here today, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. They're still enjoying everything!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How about we do our cooldown here? You know, while we look at all the cherry blossoms!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it's been a while since I last just stopped to see some cherry blossoms like this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right... You were all too busy when you were still idols...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, we did get to see them sometimes as part of special segments and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel like we're going through a really important time in our lives right now, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not just seeing the cherry blossoms like this. Even the things we've been doing together, at school, everything...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's almost weird that we're going to school like this because of how busy we used to be.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We even got to participate in the Sports Festival and choir recital.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. We've even had time to make new friends, go out together and just have fun...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Important might not be the best way to describe it, but it feels like we should be cherishing these moments.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. It's almost as if we may be having too much fun for our own good.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't think so!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: All of you worked so hard until now to give people hope! You absolutely deserve to have a little time to enjoy yourselves!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, not a little... A lot!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, if you put it that way, Minori, we might be asking a lot more of you in the future.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course! I'll do whatever I can!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
In that case...
Mind going off to buy some Japanese sweets for us?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, right now?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, some rice cakes too.
Those spring-themed ones if you can...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's be nice. Also, some sweet soybean powder ones would be good too, and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
W-W-Wait!
I don't mind running off to get them, but I don't have my wallet on me right now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sorry, Minori.
We were just joking.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No store that carries this stuff is gonna be open this early, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... You really had me going there for a second...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. But the four of us having a little Japanese sweets party together might be nice, especially if the weather stays this nice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure. We can do that at school on the rooftop or in the courtyard!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That'd be great if we really could do a little party like that!)
